newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Aug 27.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Aug 27.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Pastoral group Elders Australia Ltd said late on Monday the outlook for wool and cattle prices remains poor, making an expected flat profit result for the year to June 30, 1997. Elders earlier reported a 3.3 percent decline in net profit to A$14.05 million for 1995/96.

Argyle Diamonds, which manages the world's largest diamond mine, had not precipitated difficulties in the Indian diamond cutting industry, Argyle Diamonds managing director Gordon Gilchrist said late on Monday

The executive chairman of Australia's Ansett Airlines Ltd, Ken Cowley, has told his managers to cut A$150 million from Ansett's annual cost base of A$3 billion over the next two years, a spokesman said on Tuesday. Cowley also said Ansett wanted to raise revenues by about the same amount over that time, the spokesman said.
New Zealand investment group Brierley Investment Ltd said on Monday it has raised its stake in Australia's largest retailer, Coles Myer Ltd, to 6.8 percent from 5.01 percent previously.

Mining and civil engineering group Macmahon Holdings Ltd said late on Monday it was confident of a buoyant earnings performance in its 1996/97 financial year in the absence of a deterioration in the Australian economy. Mcmahon earlier said its net profit for the year to June 30, 1996 jumped to A$15.74 million from A$8.78 million.
